title: Bug 651577 CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns should be informed for Payment Discount lines on Unapplied Entries in the French Audit File.
summary: The FEC audit file export now populates CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns for payment discount lines on unapplied entries by using G/L entry source type and number as a fallback when customer/vendor ledger entries are unavailable.
key_points: Unapplication creates G/L entries without corresponding customer/vendor ledger entries, causing missing auxiliary account information
Added fallback logic using G/L entry source type and source number to identify the party for receivables/payables accounts
Improved FEC export completeness for unapplied payment scenarios
Added automated tests for both customer and vendor unapplication cases
quote: CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib were blank on customer/vendor receivables or payables lines created when a payment was unapplied.
